title: GuardDog JSON output
description: Output of `guarddog <ecosystem> scan|verify --output-format json`. See docs/json-output.md.

oneOf.description: Output of `scan`: a single scan result for the scanned package, directory or archive.
Output of `verify`: one entry per dependency found in the dependency file.

package.description: The package name, directory or archive path passed to `scan`. Absent from `verify` results.

issues.description: Raw hit count: one per matching metadata rule, plus the number of YARA string patterns matched by source code rules.

errors.description: Rule name (or `download-package`) mapped to an error message for anything that failed to run.

results.description: Every rule that ran, keyed by rule name.

anyOf.description: Metadata rule that did not match.
Metadata rule that matched: the explanation message.
Source code rule that did not match.

path.description: The directory that was analyzed. Present for remote packages and for local scans run with `--metadata`.

package_version.description: Version that was scanned (remote packages only).

pypi_dist_path.description: PyPI `/packages/...` path of the scanned distribution (PyPI only).

pypi_inspector_url.description: PyPI Inspector link, only when `issues` >= 1 (PyPI only).

code.description: The matched line(s), trimmed around the match.

match.description: The exact bytes that matched, or an empty string.

score_breakdown.description: Empty when there are no findings. Additional keys are only present when at least one risk was formed.

risks.description: Only present, and always empty, when there are no findings. Use the top-level `risks` instead.

threat_location.description: `<file>:<line>`, or an empty string for metadata threats.

capability_identifies.description: Null when the threat stands on its own without a capability.
